name: Rejold Barleybrew
summary: Rejold Barleybrew is a master dwarven brewer stationed in the lakeside settlement of Brewnall Village in western Dun Morogh. Devoted to perfecting hearty mountain spirits, he regularly enlists travelers to gather regional ingredients and test his potent recipes across the snowy valley.

sections.title: A Master of the Craft
sections.body: In Dun Morogh, brewing is treated not merely as trade, but as a defining art form. Rejold Barleybrew embodies this tradition from Brewnall Village, an outpost nestled near the frozen lake of the Iceflow River. Rather than settling for common tavern swill, Rejold continually refines his blends, seeking rare hops, mountain minerals, and pristine ice water to produce stouts capable of warming the stoutest dwarven warriors.

sections.title: The Search for the Perfect Stout
sections.body: Rejold is relentless in his quest for ideal flavor profiles, sending adventurous spirits across Dun Morogh to collect vital components for drinks like Shimmer Stout. Whether trading favors with the siege pilots of Steelgrill's Depot or arranging deliveries to thirsty patrons, his work ensures that the cold, trogg-plagued roads of Dun Morogh remain tolerable with an ample supply of hearty ale.

faq.answer: Rejold Barleybrew is a dwarven brewmaster residing in Brewnall Village in Dun Morogh. He is dedicated to concocting legendary dwarven ales and enlists passing adventurers to fetch ingredients and deliver experimental brews.

faq.q: Where can Rejold Barleybrew be found?
faq.answer: Rejold is located in Brewnall Village, situated in the western reaches of Dun Morogh beside the frozen waters of the Iceflow Basin.

Rejold is working on perfecting potent mountain recipes, including his signature Shimmer Stout and new experimental ales, requiring cold mountain flora and special brewing components found across the snowy hills.

faq.q: Is Rejold related to other Barleybrews in Khaz Modan?
faq.answer: Yes, Rejold belongs to the renowned Barleybrew clan of Khaz Modan, likely related to other notable brewers and tavern patrons like Malgin, Marleth, and Yorus Barleybrew.

faq.q: Why does Rejold send travelers to gnomes?
faq.answer: His errands actually tie him to fellow dwarves rather than gnomes: Pilot Bellowfiz of Steelgrill's Depot sends travelers to Rejold for a batch of Evershine, and Rejold's Shimmer Stout goes on to his brother, Mountaineer Barleybrew.
Shimmer Stout is a well-known, potent dwarven drink crafted by Rejold Barleybrew, brewed using unique mountain ingredients that give it a distinctive kick in the freezing winter climates.

angles.text: For dwarves, Rejold represents the proud mountaineering tradition of brewing strong ales that provide warmth and strength against Khaz Modan's bitter winter chill.
Culinary adventurers will appreciate Rejold's pursuit of pristine ingredients and precise recipes, treating the brewing process as an exact, venerable art.
Rejold's supply of stout helps keep Alliance spirits high across Dun Morogh, strengthening guards and travelers who brave trogg raids and harsh blizzards.
